import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['national_development']['data']

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

axes_info = [
    ('gdp_per_capita_usd', 'GDP per Capita\n(USD)', 'linear'),
    ('hdi', 'HDI\n(0-1)', 'linear'),
    ('freedom_index', 'Freedom Index\n(0-100)', 'linear'),
    ('corruption_perceptions_index', 'Corruption Perceptions\nIndex (0-100)', 'linear'),
    ('co2_emissions_per_capita_tons', 'CO₂ Emissions per Capita\n(tons)', 'linear'),
    ('military_expenditure_pct_gdp', 'Military Expenditure\n(% GDP)', 'linear'),
    ('internet_penetration_pct', 'Internet Penetration\n(%)', 'linear'),
]

palette = {
    'High': '#1b5e9a',
    'Upper-Middle': '#2a9d8f',
    'Lower-Middle': '#e9c46a',
    'Low': '#d1495b',
}

# Normalize each dimension independently to [0,1] for parallel coordinates
norm_df = df.copy()
mins, maxs = {}, {}
for col, _, _ in axes_info:
    mins[col] = df[col].min()
    maxs[col] = df[col].max()
    norm_df[col] = (df[col] - mins[col]) / (maxs[col] - mins[col])

x = np.arange(len(axes_info))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(18, 10), dpi=220)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
ax.set_facecolor('#fcfcfd')

# vertical axis guides
for i, (_, label, _) in enumerate(axes_info):
    ax.axvline(i, color='#c7ced9', lw=1.1, alpha=0.9, zorder=1)

# Highlight a few notable outliers requested by goal
highlight_countries = {
    'Qatar', 'United Arab Emirates', 'Singapore', 'Russia', 'Turkey', 'South Africa'
}

for _, row in norm_df.iterrows():
    y = [row[col] for col, _, _ in axes_info]
    group = row['income_group']
    country = row['country']
    is_hi = country in highlight_countries
    ax.plot(
        x, y,
        color=palette[group],
        alpha=0.9 if is_hi else 0.35,
        lw=2.2 if is_hi else 1.15,
        zorder=3 if is_hi else 2
    )

# Add y ticks as normalized scale and annotate real min/max for each axis
ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.02)
ax.set_yticks(np.linspace(0, 1, 6))
ax.set_yticklabels([f'{int(v*100)}%' for v in np.linspace(0,1,6)], fontsize=10, color='#4a5568')
ax.set_ylabel('Normalized Position within Axis Range (%)', fontsize=12, color='#2d3748')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([lbl for _, lbl, _ in axes_info], fontsize=11, color='#1f2937')

# Min/Max annotations per axis with units
for i, (col, _, _) in enumerate(axes_info):
    mn, mx = mins[col], maxs[col]
    if col == 'gdp_per_capita_usd':
        mn_s, mx_s = f'${mn:,.0f}', f'${mx:,.0f}'
    elif col == 'hdi':
        mn_s, mx_s = f'{mn:.3f}', f'{mx:.3f}'
    elif col in ('freedom_index', 'corruption_perceptions_index', 'internet_penetration_pct'):
        mn_s, mx_s = f'{mn:.0f}', f'{mx:.0f}'
    elif col == 'co2_emissions_per_capita_tons':
        mn_s, mx_s = f'{mn:.1f} t', f'{mx:.1f} t'
    elif col == 'military_expenditure_pct_gdp':
        mn_s, mx_s = f'{mn:.1f}%', f'{mx:.1f}%'
    else:
        mn_s, mx_s = f'{mn}', f'{mx}'

    ax.text(i, -0.055, f'Min {mn_s}', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color='#6b7280')
    ax.text(i, 1.045, f'Max {mx_s}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, color='#6b7280')

legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color=palette[g], lw=3, label=g)
    for g in ['High', 'Upper-Middle', 'Lower-Middle', 'Low']
]
ax.legend(
    handles=legend_elements,
    title='World Bank Income Group',
    frameon=False,
    ncol=4,
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.17),
    loc='upper center',
    fontsize=11,
    title_fontsize=12
)

plt.title(
    'National Development Profiles Across Seven Dimensions\nParallel Coordinates by Income Group (Approx. 2023)',
    fontsize=17,
    weight='bold',
    color='#111827',
    pad=52
)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0.02, 0.06, 0.98, 0.90])

out = '/app/output/result.png'
plt.savefig(out, dpi=220)
print(out)
